STEP 1: Place eggs in a single layer at the bottom of a pot and cover with cold water by about 1 inch
STEP 2: Bring the water to a rolling boil over medium-high heat, then remove from heat and cover
STEP 3: Let eggs sit for the desired time (10-12 minutes for hard-boiled), then transfer to ice bath to stop cooking
CONCLUSION: Properly boiled eggs are easy to peel and safe to eat when cooked for the right duration and cooled quickly.
